section_summary.extract_value: This section presents a theoretical framework for understanding the association between body dissatisfaction and positive body image in Black adolescent females, grounded in affect regulation theory. The authors describe a single study examining how body appreciation and body image flexibility relate to body dissatisfaction and BMI as a moderator in a pre-college sample of Black adolescent females, with hypothesized predictions about the strength of relationships at higher BMIs.
